role: Supplement after Undermind discovery; prior review preserved.

sources.authors: James A. Kahn; Robert W. Rich
sources.title: Tracking the new economy: Using growth theory to detect changes in trend productivity
sources.original_definition: q1=Pr(S1,t=0|S1,t-1=0), high permanent-growth regime; p1=Pr(S1,t=1|S1,t-1=1), low regime. Both recurring.
sources.method: Approximate maximum likelihood of Markov-switching dynamic factor/state-space system using Kim filter; growth-theory common permanent trend plus separate transitory component.
sources.sample: United States quarterly1947Q1–2002Q4, December2005 vintage. Output/hour and real compensation/hour shifted three quarters; consumption/hour and detrended hours included.
sources.transformation: For a first-exit/absorbing surrogate, pi_V6=q1^(4*Delta_years); annual .990^4=.96059601, 25year .990^100=.36603234. This is uninterrupted high-regime survival, not the original chain's high-state probability after a full period (which allows exit/reentry).
sources.mapping_confidence: Moderate as recurrent technology-growth duration analogue; low for V6 absorbing change in factor-spillover structure.
sources.recommendation: Prefer this as the central literature duration illustration over generic disaster hazards; label pi=.990^(4Delta) conditional scenario, not a V6 estimate. Original paper supports no clean portable credible range.
sources.uncertainty: q1±1.96SE crosses1, so Wald interval and inverse duration transform are unreliable near boundary. Few long spells and sensitivity to information set. Per-capita specification cannot identify transition probabilities when regimes collapse. Values across specifications are not a confidence interval.
sources.version_warning: 2003 NYFed and October2003 SF conference drafts have different symbols, enddates and low-duration estimates; do not combine with published table.

sources.title: The International Dynamics of R&D and Innovation in the Long Run and in the Short Run
sources.method: Panel Dynamic OLS cointegration plus VECM. Country effects and alternative trends/year effects; US patent applications weighted by initial3year citations, R&D personnel in full-time equivalents.
sources.sample: 15 OECD countries, annual1973–1999 per text; Table4 note says1972–1999; estimation390 observations after lags.
sources.classification: Estimated long-run elasticities; depreciation rates imposed choices. No estimated portable V6a level.
sources.mapping: V6 innovation law corresponds, at most under matching of patents with varieties and units, to lambda=1,phi=1,foreign exponent=0,delta=0,iota=a. BP ell is a ratio requiring phi!=1, so neither ell nor c nor source xi is V6a or V6 augmentationxi/nu.
sources.recommendation: Use as independent empirical evidence for international knowledge and decreasing-return specification review. Do not extract a_i or xi_u/nu_u numerical prior. Patent measurement, obsolescence, foreign spillovers and long-run ratios all differ.
